newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi stocks lose on political uncertainties.
newsitem.headline: Delhi stocks lose on political uncertainties.

text.p: Delhi stocks closed with moderate losses on Friday as the market slipped into a low over political uncertainties linked to court cases against former Prime Minister P.V. Narasimha Rao, brokers said.
Speculators sold heavily in the market as the benchmark index plunged 10.71 points to close at 717.21, they said.

"The chargesheet against Rao (in a forgery case) and his bail plea being rejected in the Lakhubhai Pathak case (of alleged criminal conspiracy to cheat him of $100,000) directly dented the market sentiment," said Manoj Choraria of brokers Choraria and Associates.
The 100-rupee face-value shares of ACC fell 47.75 rupees to 1,742.25 and Larsen and Toubro lost 6.30 rupees at 232.50 rupees on selling by speculators, brokers said.
State Bank of India 7.05 rupees at 252.05 on profit-taking, brokers said.
